note: The eight images of the admin, the stack and the manager. The compare-images workflow builds each twice, from a pull request's base and from the pull request merged into it, and a pull request that changes no image should see all eight match. Each side is built as its own commit's copy of this file says, so a pull request that changes how an image builds changes its entry here, and its base still builds as before. What may differ is the head's copy's to say. Each allow below is build noise that differs between any two builds, with the reason in the image's note. pnpm's own files are never allowed, because image.mjs names them whenever they differ. The contexts are the ones each project's compose file or script builds with, and every image is built with its Dockerfile's default build arguments, not the ones a deploy passes.

images.name: hls-stream-uploader
images.note: The image copies packages/stream-uploader/dist/, which is built and never committed, so each side first installs from the lockfile and builds the uploader, as deploy/scripts/deploy.sh does before it builds this image. corepack runs the pnpm the stack pins, and the build is the uploader's own script run through it rather than the stack's build:uploader, which calls a second pnpm that a machine with corepack alone does not have.

images.name: hls-stream-client
images.note: Built with the compose file's default build arguments, so both sides carry the same empty build stamp.

images.name: hls-stream-bench
images.note: bench-on-host.sh builds it with e2e/ as its context. Its build installs Debian packages and runs npm, which record when they ran, and two builds on GitHub's runner on 2026-09-27 differed in that noise alone, every file of the programs it installs the same: Node's compile cache under /tmp/node-compile-cache, written the first time npm and pnpm run, npm's cache index, whose entries carry a time, and its debug log, named for the time it started, the caches of fontconfig and ldconfig, and the logs of apt, dpkg and update-alternatives. A cache or log folder whose file names vary is allowed as a folder, and a single file by its path. npm's cached packages themselves, under _cacache/content-v2, are still compared.

images.name: hls-stream-browser
images.note: As hls-stream-bench, whose build noise it shares. browser-on-host.sh builds it through bench-on-host.sh, with the same context. Its apt install of Chrome and Xvfb also sets up dbus, which writes a random machine id, the same one into /etc/machine-id and /var/lib/dbus/machine-id, so both differ between any two builds.

images.name: infra-manager-api
images.note: Alpine's /var/log/apk.log records when apk add ran, and two builds on 2026-09-27 differed in that line alone, with every package version the same.
